description: Commerce Assurance: submit a list of expected settlements (reference, amount, currency) and a list of received transfers, with an optional default currency and tolerance. The signed report gives deterministic totals for each side and the net per currency, then each item tied to its reference: matched, missing, duplicate, short with the amount, overpaid with the amount, and unmatched transfers. Verdict reconciled or exceptions_found. POST /api/settlement-reconciliation-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no counterparty contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/commerce-assurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.
